Shaped iteration 0111 as one bounded benchmark task to preserve the completed independent WP1 review.
[Review #547](history/sessions/547/d6eb2085115b86ba4e78c52b2307ddf0d700826dc74a4d31043d5e6f9d7303ef.md) reports CLEAR for proposal integration preparation, with a nonblocking narrative-validation limitation.
Its exact artifact needs durable preservation before later method integration; no review probes need repeating.
[The graph](tasks.json) stages `547-project-text-review.json` and requires its published SHA256 before copying.
The writer checks actual artifact/git pins and creates only the preserved review and provenance note.
The task uses benchmark/default/medium, 60 minutes and 45 turns, with no dependencies.
Verification is one plain Python command checking the durable hash, JSON parsing and nonempty provenance.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) records the review outcome, remaining prerequisites and next-session handoff.
Startup diagnostics were healthy; this shaper has no shell and checks its graph/report by readback.
No session can run LabVIEW; native validity, behavior and save-version authority remain unverified.
This preparation review establishes neither trial readiness nor owner acceptance of the method.

## What next

After preservation, inspect the actual review and proposal integration handoff, then plan scoped method integration and separate review of its changed tree.
Keep historical checker/input pins intact; do not rerun completed reviews or start a trial from this recommendation.
Owner request #532 remains pending independently and does not block this task.
